== Summary ==
David Goldberg of Worcester, MA is a repeat offender, back at his second consecutive Star Trek CCG World Championships. Photo: Decipher. See [[DecipherCon 1999#Star Trek CCG World Championship|Star Trek CCG at DecipherCon 1999]] and [[DecipherCon 1999 photographs]].
